_doc: A2 World 5 props. Frame units, 2 units = 1 world px (sprites drawn at scale 0.25). pennant_*: 64 x 64, hung from "hang" (a pole top), blowing right (mirror for left). prism_lamp_* and altar_glass*: 64 x 96, "foot" on the floor, "flame" where the light (and a live flame) goes, as v2's lantern_post and altar. bell_glass*: 128 x 192 hung from (64, 20), v2's bell; rope = [x, y, w, h]. sconce_glass: 64 x 64, wick tip "flame". window_seal_*: 128 x 192 over the two-by-three doorway boss_arena.gd seals. glass_crack*: 64 x 64 overlays for a pane cell (stage 1 at strain 0.4, 2 at 0.8, 3 as it flashes).
